tools.name: orbit_attention
tools.description: List operator waits and suggested next actions; use at session start or on-call.

all.description: Read every active workspace on this host.

severity.description: Minimum severity: low, medium, high or critical.

since.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response; unusable.

tools.name: orbit_auto_task
tools.description: List, add, update or mint recurring auto-task definitions.

action.description: Operation to run, with its required fields: list; add (name, schedule, template); update (name); mint (name).

include_inactive_plugins.description: For list: Also list definitions whose seeding plugin is off in this workspace or on the host, each marked plugin_inactive with its skipped_reason.

view.description: For list: bounded: bounded metadata, explicit workspace, pagination and display truncation.

name.description: For add: Unique definition name (lowercase alphanumeric, `-`/`_`, starts alphanumeric); For update, mint: Definition name.

description.description: For add: Human description of the recurring chore; For update: New description.

schedule.description: For add: Schedule object: exactly one of `{ cron: string }` (5-field cron) `{ every_minutes: number }`, `{ deliveries_landed: { branch, threshold, max_wait_minutes, coverage, owner_machine?.

template.description: For add: Task template: `{ title, description?, acceptance_criteria?, task_type?, tags?, required_tools?, priority?, complexity?, crew?, status? }`. `complexity` is an assessed low/medium/hard/xhard.

dedupe.description: For add: Dedupe policy: `skip_if_open` (default) or `always`; For update: New dedupe policy: `skip_if_open` or `always`.

waive_batch.description: For update: Explicit settled-batch waiver: { batch_id, reason }.

enabled.description: For update: Enable (`true`) or disable (`false`) the definition.

expected_enabled.description: For update: Observed enabled state, checked atomically with the `enabled` change; the change is refused when the definition no longer matches.

acknowledge_unconditional.description: For mint: True acknowledges unconditional creation; requires operator authority.

tools.name: orbit_automation_explain
tools.description: Explain a routine's `trigger.condition`, an auto-task's `schedule.condition`.

definition.description: The routine or auto-task carrying the.

subject.description: The subject whose clause tree to show: a task.

tools.name: orbit_codebase
tools.description: Codebase analytics: ranked rollups, one key's detail, or files changed together.

action.description: Operation to run, with its required fields: show (path); related (path); analytics.

path.description: For show: A ranked key at the chosen rollup: a file path, a directory, or a crate such as crates/orbit-core/; For related: A repository-relative file path, including a deleted file with landed.

window.description: For show, analytics: Counted period ending now: 7d, 30d, 90d or all; For related: Landed period ending now.

min_support.description: For show, analytics: Smallest denominator a ranked row needs, at least 1; For related: Minimum shared landed tasks, at least 1.

rollup.description: For show, analytics: How paths are grouped: file, dir (parent directory) or crate.

nature.description: For show, analytics: Count only regressions whose regression_from link records this nature; `absent` keeps links stored without a classification, distinct from `unclassified`.

escape.description: For show, analytics: Count only regressions whose regression_from link records this escape; `absent` keeps links stored without a classification, distinct from `unclassified`.

layer.description: For show, analytics: Count only regressions whose fix sits in this layer, read from the regression task's landed paths, else its declared footprint; `unknown` when it has neither.

detected_by.description: For show, analytics: Count only regressions found this way, read from the regression task's tags, else its filer.

top.description: For related: Maximum partners, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: orbit_command_exec
tools.description: Execute a command as an explicit argv array in an explicit working directory.

argv.description: The command as a JSON array of argv strings.

working_directory.description: Absolute working directory the command runs in.

claim_token.description: Token for this workspace's exclusive claim.

tools.name: orbit_decision
tools.description: List, show or raise human decision requests.

action.description: Operation to run, with its required fields: list; show (id); raise (task_id, question, options).

gate.description: For list: Only requests waiting on this gate: agent_request, block_triage, model_answer_review, pilot_admission, proposed_approval, resident_authority, review_approval or script_grant.

task_id.description: For list: Only requests on this task; For raise: The human-crew task the decision is for.

topic.description: For list: Only requests carrying exactly this structured topic; For raise: Optional structured topic or corpus rule id (1-64 characters of letters, digits and . _ : / -), so a later reader matches.

include_closed.description: For list: Include answered, superseded and expired requests beside the open ones.

id.description: For show: The decision request id, as action `list` prints it.

question.description: For raise: One or two plain-language sentences naming the decision needed, readable without opening the code.

options.description: For raise: Two to four options as an array of {label, consequence, recommended, risk_tier?} objects. risk_tier may be routine, reversible, irreversible, authority or spend; omitted means unknown.

tools.name: orbit_friction
tools.description: Record a friction, or update one.

action.description: Operation to run, with its required fields: add (body); update (id).

body.description: For add: Markdown body describing what happened and why it caused friction; For update: Optional replacement markdown body.

title.description: For add: One-line handle identifying the problem, at most 120 characters; For update: Optional replacement one-line title, at most 120 characters; an empty string restores derivation from the body.

tags.description: For add: Friction taxonomy tags as a string or array; valid tags: automation | build | docs | history-diverged | lifecycle | naming | other | policy | skill-guidance | tooling; defaults to other; For.

during_task.description: For add: Optional task ID being worked on when friction occurred; an ID that names no task is refused.

id.description: For update: Friction record ID, e.g. FYYYY-MM-NNN.

status.description: For update: Optional status: open, triaged, or resolved.

rehome_to.description: For update: Optional registered workspace that owns a friction recorded in the wrong one; moves the record there unless `move` is false.

move.description: For update: With `rehome_to`: false records the `rehome_required` disposition without moving, for a workspace that is not registered here; defaults to true.

tools.description: Submit a durable pipeline run and return immediately with its run ID.

job_name.description: Registered v2 job name to invoke.

default_input.description: True submits an enabled, no-input catalog job.

name.description: Required for toggle and set_trigger: exact.

expected_enabled.description: Required for toggle: observed enabled state

target.description: Required for toggle and set_trigger: observed.

limit.description: For list: Maximum runs to return (default 25; values above 200 are rejected); For show: Bounded detail page size.

job_id.description: For list: Optional job ID filter.

state.description: For list: Optional concrete run-state filter, or `terminal`.

since.description: For list: Optional RFC 3339 lower bound for run creation time.

view.description: For list, show: bounded: bounded metadata, explicit workspace, pagination and display truncation.

status.description: For list: Bounded run state filter.

include_catalog.description: For list: Bounded view only: include a paginated no-input job catalog with last-run metadata alongside runs.

id.description: For show, observe, resume: Job run ID.

log_offset.description: For show: Bounded log record offset.

claim_token.description: For resume: Token for this workspace's exclusive claim, required when another operator holds one.

source_repair.description: For resume: Explicit operator recovery of an eligible stopped owner-local publication.

tools.name: orbit_search
tools.description: Search tasks and frictions using lexical matching.

query.description: Tasks match non-adjacent terms: full matches.

kind.description: Corpus kind: task, friction, or all.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, at most 1000.

all.description: Include every status for the queried kind.

all_workspaces.description: Search every active workspace registered on the.

required_tools.description: Canonical tool names added to the activity baseline.

requires_labels.description: Host capability labels the task requires.

not_before.description: Earliest dispatch time as an RFC 3339 instant.

context_files.description: Context selectors this task will change.

orchestrator_model.description: Orchestrator model when it differs from the crew.

path.description: For get: Artifact path relative to the task artifacts directory, exactly as it appears in `orbit_task_show` with `field: "artifacts"`; For put: Artifact path relative to the task artifacts directory.

source_path.description: For put: Source file to store as a task artifact.

tools.name: orbit_task_block_triage
tools.description: Triage proposed tasks a task-pilot warning holds.

subject.description: what is triaged: pilot_warning (the default and.

id.description: propose and report: the pilot-held task

summary.description: propose and report: one or two plain-language.

reason.description: report: the exact action only a human outside.

recommended.description: propose: 1-based index of the recommended option

source_revision.description: inspection proof: the pinned commit id the.

observed_revision.description: inspection proof: `git rev-parse HEAD` in the.

tools.name: orbit_task_eligible
tools.description: List backlog and proposed tasks that can be picked up now without colliding.

tools.name: orbit_task_list
tools.description: List tasks as {tasks, total, truncated}; rules are in the installed Orbit skill `references/task-fields.md`.

scheduled.description: Keep only future schedules, soonest first.

not_before_from.description: Inclusive lower schedule bound as RFC 3339.

not_before_until.description: Inclusive upper schedule bound as RFC 3339.

tag.description: Filter by tag; an array is AND.

pilot_warnings.description: Keep proposed tasks held by pilot warnings.

ready.description: Keep tasks whose dependencies are satisfied.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

fields.description: Name fields, or fetch one task with `orbit_task_show`; compact rows match `orbit tool run orbit.task.list`.

search.description: Bounded view key or title substring.

external_ref.description: Exact external reference in system:id form.

has_ref.description: Keep tasks with a reference in this system.

tools.name: orbit_task_recover
tools.description: Operator recovery for stuck claims, blocked tasks, handoffs and reviews.

action.description: Operation to run, with its required fields: recover_claim (claim_id, expected_phase, status, reason, request_key); requeue (id, reason); repilot (id); retry_handoff (handoff_id, expected_candidate_commit, expected_base_commit, expected_latest_attempt, expected_latest_state, reason, request_key); revoke_handoff (handoff_id, expected_candidate_commit, expected_base_commit, reason, request_key); review_reset (id, lineage_key, reason); reconcile_review (mode, id).

mode.description: For reconcile_review: inspect, submit, status, or accept_baseline.

claim_id.description: For recover_claim: Live claim to recover.

expected_phase.description: For recover_claim: Claim phase you observed; a claim that moved on is refused.

status.description: For recover_claim: Target status: blocked for diagnosis or backlog for retry.

reason.description: For recover_claim, retry_handoff, revoke_handoff: Required operator reason retained durably; For requeue: Required explanation retained in the task history; For review_reset: Required explanation.

request_key.description: For recover_claim, retry_handoff, revoke_handoff: Durable request key; reuse exactly after a lost reply; For reconcile_review: submit: operator-chosen key; resubmitting it replays the same.

id.description: For requeue: Blocked task to requeue; For repilot: Task to assess again; For review_reset: Task in the selected lineage; For reconcile_review: Task in review whose foreign delivery merged.

discard_candidate.description: For requeue: Discard the published or kept candidate, close the task's undelivered Orbit pull requests and let the next run implement fresh.

full.description: For repilot: Run a full assessment instead of re-checking a held one.

handoff_id.description: For retry_handoff: Immutable accepted handoff identity; For revoke_handoff: Accepted handoff whose authority to revoke.

expected_candidate_commit.description: For retry_handoff, revoke_handoff: Accepted candidate commit the operator observed.

expected_base_commit.description: For retry_handoff, revoke_handoff: Accepted base commit the operator observed.

expected_latest_attempt.description: For retry_handoff: Latest landing attempt number the operator observed.

expected_latest_state.description: For retry_handoff: Latest state; dispatched is eligible only with unresolved intent and no live owner job.

lineage_key.description: For review_reset: Exact lineage key from the admission refusal or review manifest.

adopt_configured_budget.description: For review_reset: Explicitly adopt current configured review limits; default retains the captured limits.

reconciliation_id.description: For reconcile_review: status, accept_baseline: the reconciliation to act on.

command.description: For reconcile_review: accept_baseline: the required command whose failure reproduced at the base.

remediation_commit.description: For reconcile_review: accept_baseline: commit on the landing branch, landed on top of the delivery's merge or squash commit, that remediates that failure.

Use `fields` (alias `field`) for projections, or `field: "delivery"` for bounded commit/landing evidence. Projection, routing and delivery details: installed Orbit skill `references/task-fields.md`.

snapshot.description: True returns a bounded versioned snapshot with.

fields.description: Field names to return; `delivery` is selected.

field.description: Compatibility alias for a single field.

tools.name: orbit_task_update
tools.description: Update a task and return its JSON; rules are in the installed Orbit skill `references/task-fields.md`.

not_before.description: Earliest start, or empty to clear.

source_task_id.description: Source bug ID; empty clears it.

job_run_id.description: Job run ID; empty clears it.

tools.title: Orbit control center
tools.description: Open the Orbit control center or a selected task or run panel.

action.description: open: the control center, or a task or run panel given workspace and id. inspect: a task or run panel (workspace, id required).

id.description: Public task key or run ID.

tools.name: orbit_workflow
tools.description: Ship tasks, land one, or observe and control the workspace auto-drain.

action.description: Operation to run, with its required fields: auto (mode); ship (task_ids); land (task_id).

mode.description: For auto: status, start, stop or resize; For ship: Optional ship mode (`pr` or `local`); defaults to workspace configuration.

for_seconds.description: For auto: Required for start: window length in seconds, 1 through 86400 (24 hours).

auto_concurrency.description: For auto: Start only: off, shadow or enforce for this local drain.

concurrency.description: For auto: Worker limit, positive u32.

task.description: For auto: Status only: one task ID or a list to explain instead of the bounded backlog.

limit.description: For auto: Status only: maximum tasks to explain, including an explicit selection (1-500; default 50).

allow_crew.description: For auto: Status only: configured crews to evaluate; omitted uses the live drain's restriction, if any.

id.description: For auto: Resize only: auto- or pull-drain run ID.

if_revision.description: For auto: Resize only: apply only if the run's worker limit is still at this revision, so a concurrent change is reported rather than overwritten.

reason.description: For auto: Resize only: note recorded with the change.

complete.description: For auto: Start only: explicitly authorize automatic completion for all tasks admitted by this window; default false keeps review.

review.description: For auto: Start only: add this review layer before landing (before-landing recommended; before-pr deprecated but honoured) to the window when workspace policy applies none; every task it admits.

approve_proposed.description: For auto: Start only: each pass pilots qualifying proposed tasks (tagged no-diff-expected, or with context_files and an assessed complexity) and approves into backlog those with no duplicate.

force.description: For auto: Stop only: also cancel each live drain and stop its in-flight work.

claim_token.description: For auto: Workspace claim token when held by another operator; For ship: Token for this workspace's exclusive claim, required when another operator holds one.

task_ids.description: For ship: Explicit task IDs to ship; at least one is required.

base.description: For ship: Optional base branch override.

allowed_crews.description: For ship: Optional configured crews this explicit shipment may dispatch; excluded crews are rejected before provider invocation.

task_id.description: For land: The task in review whose delivery pull request lands.
